title: Astronomy
subtitle: How we found out
summary: Everything here was worked out by people who could not leave the Earth. Eratosthenes measured it with a shadow, Bessel caught a star shifting by a third of a second of arc, a Swiss schoolteacher found the pattern in hydrogen's colours, and Jocelyn Bell's “little green men” turned out to be a spinning neutron star. The trunk ends with the expanding universe, dark matter and the question of whether time had a beginning. There are no equations.
